{{Quote|Used by New Republic troops in the battle of Glom Tho, the decisive encounter of the Hevvrol Sector Campaign. Achieved a record satisfaction rating of 97.3 percents!|An advertisement for the [[Sure-Sight|NeuroSaav Sure-Sight]]|<ref name="RPG2" />}}
The '''battle of Glom Tho''' was one of the first engagements between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Par Lankin's forces]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glom Tho]].

==Background==
After the end of the [[Nagai–Tof War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] launched its main liberation campaign against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Nantz]] was given command of the [[New Republic First Fleet|First Fleet]], and staged his campaign from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==The battle==
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Tyr Taskeen]]'s [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] forces assaulted the planet [[Glom Tho]] and seized key foundries.<ref name="TEGTW" /> New Republic troops made extensive use of [[Neuro-Saav Technologies/Legends|Neuro-Saav]] [[Sure-Sight]] [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] during the battle. Glom Tho was the decisive battle in the Hevvrol Sector Campaign and a strategic New Republic victory.<ref name="RPG2" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Surely you've followed events at Glova, Glom Tho and Druckenwell? The Empire no longer exists, and its warlords are in retreat throughout the Trailing Sectors.|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-6-showdown-at-naboo|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 6: Showdown at Naboo}}</ref>}}
The New Republic victory at Glom Tho blunted the expansion dreams of another warlord, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Par Lankin]], who ruled the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> Neuro-Saav Corporation would utilize the battle in advertising for its macrobinoculars, as New Republic troops present in the battle gave it a 97.3 percent satisfaction rating.<ref name="RPG2" />
